name: Malboro
description: When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card, loses 2 life, and exiles the top three cards of their library. {2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a Swamp card and put it into your hand.
assumptions: Treated the swampcyclingFind node's zone_from "--" as the library, given the effect shape.
Read owner:"opp" with no target flag as "each opponent" acting on their own zones.
couldNotDerive: Whether the library is shuffled after the search.
Whether the found card is revealed before going to hand.
notes: Decomposition gap, confirmed by checking the actual node: node:swampcyclingFind has flags "target cond:subtype_swamp" with no reveal/shuffle marker at all. Real oracle text is explicit: "Search your library for a Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle." Both "reveal it" and "then shuffle" are real, separate printed facts (shuffle specifically is not automatically implied by a search under current rules — a card must say "then shuffle" explicitly) that our schema currently has no flag for on a search-type move. Worth a reveal:/shuffle: flag or equivalent. Ability name ("Bad Breath", "Swampcycling") correctly omitted — expected, not counted, same as other unencoded ability names.
